title: Zesty Crisp Kenyan Lentil Stew
description: A yeasty and crisp Kenyan dish perfect for a date night, featuring dry white wine and infuse oil in a vegan friendly recipe, cooked to perfection in a copper pot.
instructions: Heat the infuse oil in a copper pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, dry white wine, and 2 cups of water to the copper pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to partially blend the stew, leaving some texture.
Continue to simmer the stew for an additional 10 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve the Zesty Crisp Kenyan Lentil Stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
